Title: General availability: Azure Automation in China

Body.Content: Azure Automation is now available in Azure’s China cloud. Azure Automation can be used to create, monitor, deploy, and maintain resources in your Azure environments, using a highly scalable and reliable process execution engine. To learn more and get started with a free trial, see the Azure Automation overview.
Body.Markdown:
Azure Automation is now available in Azure’s China cloud. Azure Automation can be used to create, monitor, deploy, and maintain resources in your Azure environments, using a highly scalable and reliable process execution engine.

To learn more and get started with a free trial, see the Azure Automation overview.
